gateName: SOVRA Phase 15.5 Final Release Gate & Multi-Tier Independent Authorization Matrix

tier_1_source_code_integration.details: ValidatorSchedule integration into block propose and apply paths, atomic AppHash commit strictly after 2/3+ quorum commit cert validation, dynamic round tracking in P2P BlockData, and fail-closed /consensus/transition endpoint requiring Bearer auth token or Ed25519 quorum signatures.

tier_2_isolated_test_verification.details: All 24 test suites (254 tests) and all Go unit tests passed with 100% pass rate. Dedicated Phase 15.5 live recovery security suite (13 tests) passed.

tier_3_upgraded_daemon_execution.runtimeEvidence: 4 independent node instances executing upgraded binary across RPC ports 26757, 26767, 26777, 26787 and P2P ports 26756, 26766, 26776, 26786.

tier_4_actual_validator_set_activation.details: Validator set strictly contains replacement keys. Compromised genesis validator keys are permanently revoked and rejected across proposal signing, prevote signing, precommit signing, commit cert aggregation, and P2P gossip.

tier_5_stable_four_node_consensus.details: Audited over 50 continuous blocks with 100% commit certificate quorum power. Sustained 3-of-4 BFT operation (75% voting power) during intentional node3 outage. Verified automatic resync and catchup upon node3 restart. Financial supply invariant (30T uSOV) conserved exactly across all 4 nodes.

local_development.rationale: All isolated unit, consensus, cryptography, and application tests operate deterministically with 100% pass rate.

local_loopback_multi_node.rationale: Four-node upgraded cluster on sovra-recovery-1 demonstrates continuous BFT consensus, atomic commits, fault tolerance, and restart recovery with replacement identities.

historical_chain_preservation.rationale: Historical ledger truth of sovra-testnet-0 (height 52,389+) preserved intact with verified SHA-256 backup manifest and zero state rewriting.

blockingPrerequisites: Provisioning of 4 physical multi-cloud server hosts across independent cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean).
Physical integration of PKCS#11 hardware security modules (AWS CloudHSM SDK 5+ or YubiHSM 2 with CKM_EDDSA).
mTLS node-to-node P2P transport network configuration across external public IPs.
Repository owner authorization and coordination of the remote Git history rewrite or explicit risk-acceptance.

production_mainnet.rationale: Mainnet authorization is permanently prohibited prior to multi-month live operation on decentralized remote testnet and formal external cryptographic audits.
